# Pocketworld 0.6.0

An agent skill for native pixel dioramas from a scene description and reference image.

- Install first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tu-Zhenzhao/pocketworld/main/INSTALL.md
- Skill: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tu-Zhenzhao/pocketworld/main/skills/pocketworld/SKILL.md
- Authoring: https://github.com/Tu-Zhenzhao/pocketworld/blob/main/docs/authoring.md
- Embedding: https://github.com/Tu-Zhenzhao/pocketworld/blob/main/docs/embedding.md
- Annotated art studies: https://github.com/Tu-Zhenzhao/pocketworld/blob/main/skills/pocketworld/references/art-studies.md
- Releases: https://github.com/Tu-Zhenzhao/pocketworld/releases/latest

Install the full skills/pocketworld directory, including assets, references and scripts. Do not install only SKILL.md. Run setup, doctor and the shipped example. Read the Skill before creating a new scene. Runtime needs Node20+; native CPU export works without Chrome using --backend cpu. Browser capture is optional; viewing geometry components needs a WebGL2-capable browser. Video/GIF encoding needs ffmpeg. See skills/pocketworld/references/runtime.md for custom-adapter boundaries. Scene authoring uses the calling agent's tools; the renderer is not an image reconstruction model.

Choose local feature budgets and readable native stills before animation. Use scripts/study.mjs for actual frames/crops without a browser. Cloud agents can deliver fresh images/media and a review package even when their localhost is unreachable; local users retain the full interactive player. Statistics never grant artistic approval.
